variants.title: NaI(Tl) calibration: unknown source B
variants.sample: Unknown sealed disc source B (strong line near 511 keV)
variants.unknown: the energy of the strongest line of source B
variants.note: The calibration uses Am-241, Ba-133, Cs-137 and Co-60 as the known sources. The unknown's line energy comes from the nuclear-data tables.

source.title: NNDC / ENSDF: Na-22 annihilation line 511.0 keV; Am-241 59.54 keV; Ba-133 80.998 keV; Cs-137 661.657 keV; Co-60 1173.228 keV

variants.title: NaI(Tl) calibration: unknown source C
variants.sample: Unknown sealed disc source C (strong line below 100 keV)
variants.unknown: the energy of the strongest line of source C
variants.note: A low-energy line: the calibration line is used near its lower end.

variants.title: NaI(Tl) calibration: unknown source D
variants.sample: Unknown sealed disc source D (strong line above 1 MeV)
variants.unknown: the energy of the strongest line of source D
variants.note: The line lies above the highest known peak, so the calibration line is extended a little beyond the points that made it.
